所需费用约为3.5亿韩元（约合人民币190万

text: 经典波音 929 单体水翼船
TurboJET 的 Jetfoil 是很多香港、澳门乘客印象最深的“喷射船”。它不是普通快船，而是水翼船：船速上来后，船体由水下翼产生升力而“抬起”，主要靠水翼支撑，船身大部分离开水面，从而显著减少阻力。

screen_text.label: ChatGPT Jetfoil performance characteristics
text: TurboJET 官方资料列明 Jetfoil 与 Premier Jetfoil 均为 Monohull hydrofoil，最高 45 节，使用 2 台 Allison 501-KF 燃气轮机与 2 套 Rockwell 水喷推进器。
Jetfoil 的核心优势是高速、抗浪、乘坐感较平稳。普通船在高速时船体与水面接触面积大，兴波阻力很高；水翼船则通过水翼把船体托离水面，湿表面积大幅下降，阻力降低，因而能以较小船体达到 40-45 节级别航速。
第一，机械复杂度高。水翼、翼柱、控制系统...
screen_text.summary: Performance characteristics and trade-offs of Jetfoils explaining wave resistance reduction and mechanical complexity.

screen_text.label: ChatGPT Jetfoil trade-offs
text: 第一，机械复杂度高。水翼、翼柱、控制系统、燃气轮机、水喷推进器都需要高水平维护。
第二，对浅水、漂浮物、码头环境更敏感，因为水翼和翼柱在水下工作。

Jetfoil 的核心优势是高速、低阻、航行姿态稳定。当船体被水翼抬升后，湿表面积大幅减少，阻力下降，因此能以约 45 节高速航行。45 节大约等于 83 km/h。

Jetfoil 的核心优势是高速、低阻、航行姿态稳定。当船体被水翼抬升后，湿表面积大幅减少，阻力下降，因此能以约 45 节高速航行。45 节大约等于 83 km/h。
但它也有明显限制：水翼、支柱、控制系统维护复杂；吃水状态变化大；靠泊、浅水区、漂浮物较多水域需要更谨慎。现代高速客轮运营中，双体船逐渐取代不少水翼船，主要原因通常是载客量、维护经济性和运营灵活性更好。

Foilcat 的特点
Foilcat 可以理解为：
双体船的横向稳定性 + 水翼船的减阻高速能力
它比单体水翼船宽，横稳性好；比常规双体船多了水翼升力，高速时阻力更低。但结构复杂度维护要求也更高。
2.3 Tricat: 高速双体船
Tricat 是 TurboJET 船队中的高速双体船。它没有像 Foilcat 那样以水翼抬升船体，而是依靠两个细长船体降低兴波阻力，并通过较宽船宽提供横向稳定性。

screen_text.label: ChatGPT Interface
text: 4.2 双体船为什么适合香港—澳门高速客运？
双体船有几个很适合珠江口高速客运的特点：
第一，横向稳定性好。两个船体之间距离较宽，横摇比很多单体船小，乘客体感更稳。
第二，甲板面积大。同等长度下，双体船可布置更宽客舱，座位、行李区、通道、服务区更容易安排。
第三，细长船体阻力较低。高速航行时，船体兴波阻力很关键。双体船每个片体较细，能在高速段保持较好的效率。
第四，浅吃水。例如 Austal Cat 满载吃水约 1.63 m，Tricat 满载吃水约 1.60-2.40 m，适合码头靠泊和近岸

screen_text.label: ChatGPT Hydrofoil Explanation
text: 普通船高速航行时，大部分阻力来自船体与水的接触、兴波、涡流和摩擦。水翼船高速后把船体抬离水面，水中只剩下支柱和水翼，湿表面积大幅减少，因此阻力下降。

segments.environment: I am seated inside an enclosed passenger ferry cabin traveling over the sea during daytime under overcast skies. To my left is a continuous row of large rectangular XXX windows framed by off-white paneling, looking directly out onto green-blue sea waves and a distant forested island ridge. Above the windows, an emergency route sign is affixed to the light-wood-textured wall panel XXX 'PRIMARY ESCAPE ROUTE 主逃生路线 Via de fuga principal' with a green arrow pointing forward. The ceiling consists of light gray curved acoustic panels with a flush rectangular LED light fixture illuminated above. Rows of blue fabric passenger seats face forward; in the row ahead of me, seats are fitted with white textile headrest covers bearing color travel cards titled '九洲港/香洲港往返各海岛航班信息' (Jiuzhou Port/Xiangzhou Port Island Ferry Schedule) and '珠海海岛随心达', along with QR codes and text '扫码使用卫星WiFi'. Below each headrest are black foldable seatback tray tables with recessed cup holders, numbered stickers (seat '2' and '3'), and blue mesh seatback pockets holding instruction sheets marked '救生衣穿着法 / How to use the lifejacket'. In the seat to my left foreground, a female passenger with dark hair tied up in an off-white claw clip rests while wearing a white long-sleeve top, with a cream shoulder bag beside her. Ahead in seat 2 sits a passenger with black hair facing forward. A flat-screen television is mounted XXX against the forward cabin bulkhead, displaying a promotional travel XXX about Zhuhai and ferry cruises. Ambient audio consists of the steady deep rumble and engine hum of the ferry cruising through water.

segments.action: I sit in my ferry seat and look at the headrest ad on Seat 3 in front of me while watching the cabin comfort features shown on the bulkhead monitor.
segments.action_brief: I watch the promotional XXX on the cabin monitor.
segments.environment: Physical space: An enclosed, well-lit passenger ferry cabin with recessed ceiling square panel lights, tiled flooring with geometric diamond patterns, stainless steel stanchion poles, curtained side luggage racks or storage counters, and large passenger windows on the left showing daylight over the water. A fellow passenger is seated in front to the left in seat 2. Objects: Purple fabric passenger seats with white headrest covers, drop-down tray tables, seat-back storage pouches containing safety instruction brochures ('救生衣穿戴法'), and numbered seat labels ('3' and '2'). Displays: A large flat-screen TV monitor mounted on the forward bulkhead playing a tourism and travel promotional XXX, and a smaller secondary monitor mounted further back on the upper right ceiling. Screen content: The main TV displays a travel clip showcasing ferry travel amenities, showing a woman smiling in the cabin and spacious seating rows with XXX '船上座位宽敞舒适' followed by '无论是静坐观景还是稍作休息'. XXX text: '九洲港/香洲港出发 珠海海岛随心达', '3 扫码使用卫星WiFi', '救生衣穿戴法'. Ambient audio: Low hum of the ferry marine engine, air conditioning airflow, and XXX audio playing.

segments.action: I hold my phone with both hands and open Google Maps while seated in the ferry cabin.
segments.action_brief: I open Google Maps.
segments.environment: Physical space: An enclosed passenger cabin of a XXX-speed ferry boat. Two rows of upholstered seats (blue fabric on seat 2, purple fabric on seat 3) are directly in front of me with white headrest covers. To my left, a passenger wearing a white shirt and dark pants rests asleep. On the far left, a cabin window looks out toward the sea under daylight. Tiled cabin floor with geometric patterns. Furniture/objects: Seat backs feature fold-down tray tables, seat pockets with printed lifejacket safety instructions ('救生衣穿着法 How to use the lifejacket'), satellite Wi-Fi QR stickers ('扫码使用卫星WiFi BlueSeajet-95'), and advertising posters ('九洲港/香洲港出发 珠海海岛随心达 九洲港/香洲港 往返各海岛航班信息'). Overhead display: A TV monitor mounted centrally on the cabin bulkhead plays a promotional tourism XXX about coastal ferry routes with subtitles ('最佳观赏拍摄时机表'). Phone display: An iPhone in a pink/orange protective case displaying 6:21 and 5G connection, switching to Google Maps. Ambient audio: Continuous low rumble of marine diesel engines and cabin ventilation.
segments.details: I grip the edges of the phone with both hands, using my thumbs to operate the touch screen.

segments.action: I look at the Google Maps interface tracking our position south of Lantau Island (大嶼山) and Fan Lau (分流炮台).

The overhead XXX transitions to showcase ocean waters and coastal landmarks.
segments.details: My gaze focuses on the blue location dot and the nearby Lantau Island coastline.

In front of me is seat back #3 with a purple fabric pocket containing a safety instructional leaflet ('救生衣穿着法 How to use the lifejacket'), a seatback fold-down tray table, and an antimacassar headrest cover featuring an advertisement banner for island ferry routes ('九洲港/香洲港出发 珠海海岛随心达'). Overhead to the front left and front right are mounted TV display screens. Displays: My smartphone screen displays Google Maps showing northern Vietnam (Hà Nội, Hải Phòng, Nam Định) with top search bar '在此处搜索' and bottom navigation tab bar ('探索', '我', '贡献', '本地生活脉搏'). The overhead TV screens display promotional tourism videos introducing the ferry '浪漫珠海'号. segments.environment: Physical space: Interior passenger cabin of a moving ferry boat with cream/white paneled walls, white ceiling equipped with recessed LED spot lighting, emergency light fixtures, and a tiled floor with dark border lines. Objects: To the left stands a sealed white exit door with a silver latch handle and warning labels; beneath the central window runs a long white countertop with a folded blue cloth/gloves resting on the left edge; underneath the countertop is a built-in cabinet featuring dual trash inlet flaps ('垃圾投入口') and grey pleated curtains screening XXX storage bays; on the right wall hangs a flat-screen TV monitor playing a XXX broadcast; in the foreground, my legs rest stretched out wearing grey sweatpants and white sneakers. Screen content: TV display on the right wall is broadcasting scenic/promotional footage with cityscapes and bridge visuals. Text in the world: '安全出口 EXIT' above the door; '主逃生路线 PRIMARY ESCAPE ROUTE' with a left-pointing arrow above the window; '禁止吸烟 NO SMOKING', '本区域已安装视频监视', and '扫码使用卫星WiFi' on the upper wall panel; '航行时禁止外出' and '航行时保持关闭' on the door placards; '垃圾投入口 The Garbage Inlet' on the XXX cabinet panels. Media being played: TV monitor displaying XXX programming. Ambient audio: Continuous low hum of the marine engine and subtle vessel vibration.

segments.environment: Physical space: An enclosed passenger cabin of a XXX-speed passenger ferry, featuring cream/white interior walls, ceiling panels with recessed circular lighting and an angled light fixture, and grey-toned floor tiles. On the left is an emergency exit door with a metal latch handle, bearing stickers XXX '航行时禁止外出' and '航行时保持关闭', with an overhead '安全出口' exit sign. Along the center wall is a large rectangular window showing the exterior deck, metal railings, and the open sea under daytime lighting. Below the window runs a white counter with grey privacy curtains underneath and a waste cabinet labeled '垃圾投入口 / The Garbage Inlet' with a green arrow. To the right of the window is a window with a pulled-down cream roller shade, and further right is a wall-mounted TV monitor. Above the window, wall signs display '主逃生路线 / PRIMARY ESCAPE ROUTE', '禁止吸烟 / NO SMOKING / NÃO É PERMITIDO FUMAR', and '本区域已安装视频监视'. On the counter sits a crumpled blue cloth or pair of gloves. In the foreground, my legs are stretched out wearing light grey sweatpants, white socks, and grey sneakers. Displays: The wall-mounted TV on the right is playing promotional travel footage of harbor cityscapes and illuminated skyscrapers. World text: '安全出口', '主逃生路线 PRIMARY ESCAPE ROUTE', '禁止吸烟 NO SMOKING', '本区域已安装视频监视', '航行时禁止外出', '航行时保持关闭', '垃圾投入口 The Garbage Inlet'.
